| `analyze.chapters` | Analyze a transcript and generate chapter markers at topic boundaries. | ts | `analyze/chapters.ts` |

| `analyze.video` | QC report: black frames, freeze frames, audio peaks, codec/duration/aspect/fps. | ts | `analyze/video.ts` |

| `video.dedup` | Sample frames, dHash each (9x8 grayscale -> 64-bit), cluster near-duplicates via Hamming distance. Returns timestamped groups so the agent can dedup. | ts | `video/dedup.ts` |
| `video.scene_detect` | Deterministic scene-change detection via ffmpeg select=gt(scene,TH). Returns cut times + optional smart re-assembly. | ts | `video/scene_detect.ts` |
